drift_factors.title: In sync with the baseline commit
drift_factors.detail: Both the source index and the Agent context were generated from commit 3648988c24af4765ce097bfce94c36802afa799a, with no file drift relative to HEAD.

drift_factors.title: Source index generated 36 days ago
drift_factors.detail: The longer since the last Repomix pack, the more extra points are lost (about 1 per day, capped at 5).

drift_factors.title: Agent context discounted as a derived asset
drift_factors.detail: context.md is derived from the source index by an LLM, so its confidence is discounted to 90%: raw score 95/100 → 85/100. This layer is therefore capped at 90, and the overall score cannot be higher either.

drift_factors.title: Overall score is driven by the Agent architecture context
drift_factors.detail: The overall score is the lowest of the three layers: source index 95, Agent context 85, human docs 95.
